title.en: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE DESIGNATION BY COMMANDING GENERALS OF MILITARY DEPARTMENTS OF CIVILIANS TO PERFORM AD INTERIM THE DUTIES OF INSPECTORS OF CUSTOMS AND TO FIX TEMPORARY COMPENSATION.
title.orig: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE DESIGNATION BY COMMANDING GENERALS OF MILITARY DEPARTMENTS OF CIVILIANS TO PERFORM AD INTERIM THE DUTIES OF INSPECTORS OF CUSTOMS AND TO FIX TEMPORARY COMPENSATION.

source.name: The LawPhil Project — Arellano Law Foundation

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil PDF 文本化成果（第三方 OCR，非机翻），原始文件 ACT_00046_1900_html.txt

text.en:
Whenever, through the withdrawal of garrisons from towns of the Archipelago open to the
coasting trade, the office of inspector of customs becomes vacant, commanding generals of military
departments are authorized to designate civilians, preferably the chief officers of towns, to perform ad
interim the duties of said office.

Civilian incumbents of said office, designated under section one of this Act, shall, during the
period of their service as such be compensated therefor at a rate to be fixed by department commanders and
not exceeding forty dollars gold per month.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, November 12, 1900.
